The scores from the paths indicate a consistent and plausible mechanistic link, with each compound acting as a modulator of the target kinase, ultimately influencing HCC1937. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same kinase suggests a potential therapeutic strategy, where the choice of compound could influence the efficacy or side effects of the treatment. The integrated evidence supports a mechanistic pathway where Npc115753 may act through these kinases to affect HCC1937, though further experimental validation is required to confirm the exact role of Npc115753 in this process.
